lazy_imports.why: A new pid, a later start time, and the official cgroup do not show which module object a process imported.
lazy_imports.supervisor: engine_supervisor.py does not import book.py or gate_v2.py.
lazy_imports.vd_engine_daemon: gate_v2 is imported inside history_check, which the first scoring cycle calls. book.py is imported there only when a non-FX ADV is missing. Neither import runs at process start.
lazy_imports.desk_round: python -m veteran_desk.desk run is a new interpreter. risk_gate imports gate_v2 and book. The 20:20:59 child 1950524 had an unreadable cwd and is not that proof.
lazy_imports.tick: Each tick is a new python -m veteran_desk.book tick. Stops stay on tfo-thf-tick.timer.

source.stop_owned: SIGTERM calls stop_owned, which terminate()s only self.child and waits 10s. It does not SIGKILL.
source.probe: ps matches every veteran_desk.vd_engine daemon. engine_child_alive is true while any such pid exists, so the official supervisor does not spawn.
source.spawn_guard: healing_guard refuses spawn when engine_child_alive is not false, when a desk round makes busy true, or when maintenance is unknown.
source.unit: KillMode=control-group and Restart=always. A unit restart kills only the official cgroup and leaves 833092 in the user session.

handover.watch: After the signal, poll every 5s for 45s. Do not send a second signal.
success: 833092 is absent and 833089 has not started another engine_supervisor.
Exactly one vd_engine daemon, and its ppid is the official MainPID.
337359 is still alive and the tick timer is still active.
handover.if_no_daemon_appears: Read state/vd_engine/supervisor_health.json and state/thf/recovery_guard.json. If a desk round is still present, wait for it to exit and for one more supervisor step. Do not systemctl restart and do not start python by hand.
handover.if_bash_restarts_a_supervisor: Stop. One daemon under the new leftover is the same split. Do not signal again in this step.
handover.if_child_survives: 833092 exits even when wait() times out. An orphaned daemon is still one writer. Do not SIGKILL it.
handover.rollback: PID 1941386 cannot be restored. The official supervisor's existing spawn is the replacement. There is no file rollback and no second manual daemon.
handover.stops: The tick keeps running through the step. The engine gap is the scoring daemon, not the stop path.
